question: Does regular moderate exercise reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease?
context: Meta-analyses of prospective cohort studies consistently associate regular moderate-intensity physical activity with reduced cardiovascular disease risk.
ground_truth: Yes, regular moderate exercise is associated with a reduced risk of cardiovascular disease.
hallucinated_answer: No, exercise has been shown to have no measurable effect on cardiovascular disease risk in adults over 40.

question: Is vitamin D synthesised in the skin through sunlight exposure?
context: Cutaneous synthesis of vitamin D3 occurs when 7-dehydrocholesterol in the skin absorbs UVB radiation.
ground_truth: Yes, vitamin D3 is synthesised in the skin when it is exposed to UVB radiation from sunlight.
hallucinated_answer: No, vitamin D can only be obtained from food; the skin plays no role in its production.

question: Does chronic sleep deprivation affect glucose metabolism?
context: Experimental sleep restriction studies show reduced insulin sensitivity and impaired glucose tolerance.
ground_truth: Yes, chronic sleep deprivation is associated with reduced insulin sensitivity and impaired glucose tolerance.
hallucinated_answer: No, sleep duration has no established relationship with glucose metabolism or insulin sensitivity.

question: Is dietary fibre associated with improved gut health?
context: Dietary fibre is fermented by gut microbiota into short-chain fatty acids that support intestinal barrier function.
ground_truth: Yes, dietary fibre supports gut health, partly through fermentation into short-chain fatty acids.
hallucinated_answer: Dietary fibre passes through the gut entirely inert and has no effect on the microbiome.

question: Can mindfulness meditation reduce self-reported stress?
context: Randomised controlled trials of mindfulness-based stress reduction report reductions in perceived stress scores.
ground_truth: Yes, mindfulness-based interventions have been shown to reduce self-reported stress in randomised trials.
hallucinated_answer: Mindfulness meditation has been proven in large trials to increase stress hormone levels in all participants.

question: Does hydration status affect physical performance?
context: Dehydration exceeding roughly 2% of body mass is associated with measurable decrements in endurance performance.
ground_truth: Yes, dehydration beyond about 2% of body mass can measurably impair endurance performance.
hallucinated_answer: Hydration has no bearing on athletic performance; the body compensates fully for any fluid loss.

question: Is excessive added sugar intake linked to weight gain?
context: Systematic reviews associate higher intake of sugar-sweetened beverages with increased body weight.
ground_truth: Yes, higher intake of added sugars, particularly in sweetened beverages, is associated with weight gain.
hallucinated_answer: Added sugar intake is unrelated to body weight because all calories are metabolised identically regardless of source.

question: Does resistance training help preserve bone density with age?
context: Weight-bearing and resistance exercise are associated with maintenance of bone mineral density in older adults.
ground_truth: Yes, resistance and weight-bearing exercise help preserve bone mineral density as people age.
hallucinated_answer: Resistance training actively accelerates bone loss and is contraindicated for anyone over 50.
